description: This Java class represents a data model for importing book data from LibraryThing. It uses Jackson annotations for JSON serialization/deserialization, Lombok annotations for boilerplate code, and contains fields for title, author, publication year, and ISBN.

classes.name: LibraryThingBookImport
classes.description: A POJO for importing book data from LibraryThing, with JSON properties for title, author, year, and ISBN.
